rule: Each L-shaped body carries a diagonal marker in its bend. If a lone pixel has the marker's colour, the shape is translated without rotation so that its L-corner sits on that pixel, covering it. Shapes without a matching lone pixel stay put, and non-matching lone pixels are left unchanged.
scope: Translate marked L-shaped bodies onto matching lone pixels, aligning the L-corner rather than the marker cell. Black background, 10..30 random canvases (requested 5..30), two to five default shapes, exact one to six shapes/one to six movers/zero to four distractors, all four orientations, arms 2..5.

authored_scope:
Supported:
- Black background.
- Random grids of 10-20 per side by default; explicit width and height may be 5-30. Sizes above the fixtures' 12x13 are a synthetic extension.
- 2-5 shapes by default, or 1-6 when requested.
- Arm lengths 2-5 and all four orientations.
- 1-3 movers by default, always with at least one stationary shape. Explicit num_moving may equal num_shapes.
- 0-2 distractor lone pixels by default, or 0-4 when requested.
- A body colour may coincide with another shape's marker colour.

Deliberately not supported:
- Multiple lone pixels sharing a marker colour.
- Moves that would clip at the border.
- Shapes touching each other, in the input or after moving.
- Non-L bodies, and arms of length 1.
- Non-black backgrounds.
authored_constraints: Markers are pairwise distinct. Bodies are pairwise distinct. Each body differs from its own marker.
Every moving shape has exactly one lone pixel of its marker colour. Distractor colours never equal any marker colour.
All input objects (shape bounding boxes, targets, distractors) are separated by at least one background cell, including diagonally.
Arms have length 2 or more, so the L-corner is the unique body cell with both horizontal and vertical body neighbours.
A target is never inside or adjacent to its own shape's original bounding box, so every mover really moves.
Moved shapes stay fully in bounds. Their output bounding boxes are 8-separated from stationary shapes, distractors and other moved shapes.
Explicit shapes need width and height. Singles without shapes, and count controls combined with explicit shapes, are rejected with ValueError.
Requested parameters that turn out infeasible raise ValueError after a bounded number of attempts. No fixed fallback scene is returned.
